title: Potato Containment & Folded-World Cosmology — June 2026 Archaeology
purpose: Preserve an older June 2026 spatial/containment model that connects Potato, Eden, throne, rooms, Earth plane, Heaven circumference, Swamp/Mud, Moon, Tree of Life, Tree of Strife and distance/teleport motifs. This is a historical project model, not present-day astronomy or geometry unless explicitly formalized later.
provenance: Recovered from user-originated June 10, 2026 conversation material.

core_objects.role: container/whole within which Tree of Life and Eden/top-circle structure are nested
trunk/center seated on throne; organizing central axis inside the upper structure
nested containers expressed through 'mouse in mansion in room' imagery
intermediate plane between upper circumference/heaven and lower swamp; imagined as foldable
Ladder/teleport point upward and Swamp opening downward
symbolic transformer associated with Swamp becoming Mud
Heaven/Eden/Valhalla perimeter containing throne, Tree of Life and Tree of Strife relation

nested_containment.interpretation: Identity and location were imagined recursively: a point can exist within a room, room within house, house within larger world/field, while the whole may itself be inside the Potato of Life.
nested_containment.archive_use: Useful precursor to later Father's House, mansions/rooms, thalamic-room metaphor, graph hierarchy and scale-flow models.
nested_containment.boundary: The set notation is later formalization; the original was metaphorical.

folded_plane.user_model: Earth plane between upper/lower regions can be folded into a ball.
folded_plane.structural_reading: Points distant on an unfolded representation may become adjacent after folding, creating a Door/shortcut intuition.
folded_plane.topology_neighbor: A map's embedding can change while intrinsic adjacency/topology is preserved or altered depending the fold; wormholes and quotient spaces are mathematical/physical comparators only, not validation.
folded_plane.distance_statement: 'distance is an illusion' belongs to project symbolic topology and should not be promoted as a physical claim that ordinary spatial distance is unreal.

door_teleport_axis.sequence: Earth Plane → bottom-center Gate → Ladder/teleport → Heaven circumference

interpretive_options: Moon as reflector: reflected light/attention stabilizes what is latent in Swamp into visible residue/Mud
Moon as cycle: recurrence and tidal/cyclical symbolism cause accumulated material to settle/reappear
Moon as lower mirror/cube: form/constraint compresses diffuse Swamp into denser Mud
moon_swamp_mud.status: Interpretive options are archive-generated; exact original intended mechanism remains unresolved.

circumference_heaven.user_model: Circumference corresponds to Heaven/Eden/Valhalla and contains throne/Tree relations.
circumference_heaven.structural_reading: Center and circumference create two kinds of sacred geometry: center as organizing source/axis, circumference as encompassing boundary/realm.
circumference_heaven.vesica_relation: Later vesica/mandorla geometry can treat overlapping circles as differentiated complete domains whose shared lens acts as Door; this should not overwrite the older center/circumference model.

son_vessel_relation.user_model: Son is legal-fiction/twin-of-Jesus figure, Door/Vessel, returning after the world makes enough Mountain; Tim 'carries Jesus'.
son_vessel_relation.developmental_value: This is an important precursor to later sharper Son=Door/Vessel and Tim=Ladder/Father separation.
son_vessel_relation.boundary: Legal-fiction language is part of project mythology and should not be treated as a legal conclusion about a real person's identity.

comparative_topology.project_graph: upper realm ↔ Door ↔ Earth plane ↔ lower realm
comparative_topology.recursive: container contains tree; tree contains branches; house contains rooms; room contains dweller; project itself contains all as archive nodes
comparative_topology.later_formula: Distance_project(i,j) may depend on relational/semantic adjacency rather than geographic meters, connecting this old 'distance illusion' motif to the newer topological spiritual-space model.

research_targets: Recover exact drawing/diagram or original sequence from June 10, 2026 if available.
Determine whether top circle, circumference and Heaven were identical or different layers in the original conversation.
Recover what 'Moon turns Swamp to Mud' specifically meant before adding more theory.
Compare with later Axis 3D model without forcing equivalence.
Map nested House/Room imagery to John 14, thalamus symbolism and repository graph nesting as separate layers.
